Ridley Scott's film 'The Dog Stars' receives mixed critical reviews

Ridley Scott's new film, 'The Dog Stars,' has garnered a range of critical responses. Some reviews describe the post-apocalyptic drama as lethargic, oddly blissful, or a misfire. Others highlight elements of finding hope and friends in a post-apocalyptic setting, with one review noting it as a gentle neo-western. The film stars Jacob Elordi, Margaret Qualley, and Josh Brolin.
